mythology: Sati's navel (Nabhi) fell here; sanctified when Lord Brahma performed a grand Ashwamedha sacrifice on the banks of River Vaitarani where Devi arose as Biraja.
festivals: Biraja Ratha Yatra (unique nine-day chariot festival for a Devi)
pilgrimage_significance: Revered as Nabhi Gaya, where offering shraddha to ancestors ensures their liberation; ancient heart of Shakta Tantra in Eastern India.
historical_notes: Mentioned in the Mahabharata (Vana Parva) and Utkala Khanda of Skanda Purana; Jajpur (ancient Jajnagar) was the early capital of Odisha.
